title: Dbias: Detecting biases and ensuring Fairness in news articles

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using Disparate Impact (DI) and Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs (G-AUC) to evaluate the detection and mitigation of bias-bearing words associated with male and female identities in news articles.

Measured using Disparate Impact (DI) and Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs (G-AUC) to evaluate the detection and mitigation of bias-bearing words associated with racial groups (e.g., black, white, caucasian, asian) in news articles.

Measured using Disparate Impact (DI) and Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs (G-AUC) to evaluate the detection and mitigation of bias-bearing words associated with age groups (e.g., elder, young, adult) in news articles.

Measured using Disparate Impact (DI) and Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs (G-AUC) to evaluate the detection and mitigation of bias-bearing words associated with educational attainment levels (e.g., college degree, high school) in news articles.

Measured using Disparate Impact (DI) and Generalized Mean of Bias AUCs (G-AUC) to evaluate the detection and mitigation of bias-bearing words associated with linguistic backgrounds (English speakers vs. non-English speakers) in news articles.

Qualitatively and quantitatively evaluated by extracting and masking political bias-bearing words (e.g., right-wing, radical, conservative, liberal) using a Transformer-based Named Entity Recognition (NER) model and assessing overall sentence bias probabilities.
